quotes.text: `${protocol} should be selected after a moved click on its card`

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The protocol card keeps a native radio inside its label and overlays that radio across the card with opacity0, while the content has pointer-events:none and the card disables text selection. The regression waits for click/change and asserts selection after an eight-pixel moved click. The checked value is the form state used for manual protocol configuration. This is a scoped source/test contract; no live pointer, keyboard, accessibility-tree or layout result was measured.
title: The protocol card lets its native radio receive a moved click
